evidence.snippet: Add https://mcp.attio.com/mcp as a remote MCP server and complete the OAuth authentication when prompted.
Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.

decisions.reason: Attio's own docs explicitly host and document this MCP server URL as their official hosted MCP server, confirmed by attio.com/platform/mcp marketing page describing the same first-party MCP offering.
